query: SELECT campus, AVG(headcount) as avg_weekly_adults FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In' AND cancelled = 0 GROUP BY campus UNION ALL SELECT campus, AVG(headcount) as avg_weekly_adults FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND subgroup LIKE 'Revolution%Check-In' AND cancelled = 0 GROUP BY campus;
